explication: Jaeger UI is a browser application for exploring distributed traces and service behavior. Users search for traces, open a result, and inspect its spans through timeline, flamegraph, and graph views; related workflows compare traces and examine service metrics and dependencies. The UI also includes deep-dependency analysis and an assistant surface. The graph maps the principal routes and query/API boundary, plus domain analysis layers visible in the tree. Several feature links rely on module names and documented hook behavior; unsampled implementation details are not asserted.
